name: openbb_regulators_sec_filings
description:
SEC filings for one company (form, dates, report URL) through the OpenBB Platform (obb.equity.fundamental.filings).
Returns: {tool, provider, data_points (rows before the cap), truncated, data: rows with their dates, ignored_arguments when some did not apply} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): symbol*; form_type (e.g. 10-K, 8-K); limit (filings; default 20); provider (fmp, intrinio, nasdaq, sec; default sec).
Other sources: edgar_company_submissions, edgar_filings_by_form, fmp_sec_filings. Keys: nasdaq, sec need none; fmp uses SAJHA's FMP_API_KEY; intrinio needs a key in ~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL", "form_type": "10-K", "limit": 5}
